SERVICE COMMISSIONS (AMENDMENT OF SCHEDULE)
REGULATIONS 1991

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 13 of the Service
74157.          Commissions Ordinance 1957, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes
the following regulations:

Citation and       1. (1) These Regulations may be cited as the Service Commissions

and (3).

the 1st January 1991.

(3) Paragraph 2 (b) shall be deemed to have come into force on
the 1st March 1991.
